subject.title: docs: add Agent37 managed hosting install guide

question: Should OpenClaw’s official Hosting navigation endorse Agent37 as a named managed-hosting provider despite the current commercial-service scope guardrail?
rationale: The branch is structurally consistent with an existing guide, but whether first-party docs should promote this commercial service is a repository-scope decision that source review and CI cannot make.

options.title: Decline the core-docs entry
options.body: Keep the Hosting docs provider-neutral and direct Agent37-specific onboarding material to Agent37’s own documentation.

options.title: Approve a narrow exception
options.body: Sponsor this guide explicitly and define the review criteria for future commercial managed-hosting entries so the exception is not ad hoc.

recommendation.title: Decline the core-docs entry
recommendation.body: Keep the Hosting docs provider-neutral and direct Agent37-specific onboarding material to Agent37’s own documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the current repository scope policy, not the mechanical documentation pattern.
